response.answer: Dr. Li Wei is a leading researcher in motivation scales for DVT prophylaxis in post-arthroplasty patients, focusing on the Protection Motivation Theory. He developed and validated the Deep Vein Thrombosis Prophylaxis Motivation Scale (DVT-PMS). His work aims to improve patient outcomes after hip and knee surgeries.
